persos.desc: grandfather in his 70s, ruby-and-copper kaftan, small goatee, holding ONE single wooden walking cane
persos.pose: sitting on a stool in the middle, cane planted in front of him, strict

persos.desc: teen boy around 14, silver-and-apricot t-shirt, guilty grin, hands joined in front of him
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, hands joined, proud of himself

persos.nom: the angry neighbor behind the wall
persos.desc: neighbor woman in her 40s, mustard-and-plum jumpsuit, a head scarf, both hands on top of the low wall
persos.pose: standing behind the low wall on the right, both hands on the wall, furious

dialogue: Pour le pardon, la tradition demande un cabri dêh !
C'est fait, Papi. Le cabri est attaché dans la cour.
Vieux père, c'est mon cabri-là ! Votre pardon est volé dêh !
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The grandfather taps his cane once and states the rule sternly. The grandson smiles proudly and nods toward the tied goat. The neighbor, behind the low wall, slaps one hand on the wall and shouts her line, her face clearly visible.
chute: The grandfather slowly turns his head toward the grandson while the goat bleats. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the grandson's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE CABRI EN ÉCOUTANT LA DISPUTE :
mecanisme: arroseur arrosé + témoin (la voisine) : le pardon traditionnel est payé avec un cabri volé

lieu: rooftop terrace of a building in Plateau, Abidjan, a ring light on a tripod, a plastic chair, office towers behind, late afternoon

persos.desc: grandson around 17, lavender-and-gold tracksuit, sulky face, holding ONE single smartphone
persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, holding the phone, frowning

persos.desc: grandmother in her late 60s, saffron-and-amber kaba, sunglasses resting on top of her head, hands on her hips
persos.pose: standing on the right in front of the ring light, hands on her hips, confident

dialogue: Mamie, arrête de danser en vidéo-là, c'est la honte dêh !
La honte ? J'ai deux cent mille abonnés. Et toi ?
Quarante seulement, Mamie.
Trente-huit, c'est mes copines par pitié dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The grandson waves his phone and scolds her, embarrassed. The grandmother, hands on her hips, answers with a proud smirk. The grandson lowers his eyes and mumbles his answer. The grandmother turns her face three-quarters to the camera and delivers her line with a pitying smile.
chute: The grandson's shoulders drop and his mouth falls open. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the grandson's humiliated face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE PETIT-FILS EN BLOQUANT LES COPINES DE MAMIE :
mecanisme: arroseur arrosé : le petit qui a honte de Mamie découvre que son petit public, c'est elle qui le lui prête
